title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. translated_title: WEIR：面向多轮智能体强化学习的分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩
translated_abstract: 多轮语言模型智能体通常只在长交互轨迹结束时收到单一的二元奖励，这使得难以将决定性决策与常规步骤区分开来，也难以估计准确的中介价值。前缀树方法通过合并共享动作历史的轨迹来提高样本效率，但仍存在两个结构性缺陷：朴素的池化以固定权重将过时的离策略结果混入评论家目标中，而均匀或熵驱动的分支则会将后续展开浪费在结果已经注定的死端状态上。我们提出了WEIR（分水岭探索与内在漂移收缩），这是一个基于Doob轮次方差守恒恒等式的演员-评论家强化学习框架。WEIR维护一棵具有指数折扣访问计数的跨迭代规范动作前缀树，并训练一个以前缀为条件的评论家，使其趋向于一个自适应的最小最大漂移感知收缩目标……
tldr: 提出基于Doob轮次方差守恒的WEIR框架，通过分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩机制，解决多轮智能体强化学习中稀疏奖励下难以区分关键决策及样本浪费的问题。
en_tdlr: WEIR introduces watershed exploration and drift-aware prefix shrinkage grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity to improve sample efficiency and decision attribution in multi-turn agent reinforcement learning with sparse rewards.
